# App Statuses

# App Statuses

Every app in SeaTalk Open Platform has an associated Status, which controls what the app can do and how end user can access the app. As a developer, you can use these statuses as a quick and lightway method to make your app accessible or inaccessible to the users as you push new features or fix bugs. The table below outlines app behaviour for each status.

|Status|Description|Capabilities|Status Transitions|
|---|---|---|---|
|Not Configured|Your app is not fully set up yet. Do either of the following to bring it Online: Enable Bot or Login with SeaTalk capability Enable Workspace App capability AND create a release|Can call APIs, excluding Messaging APIs Cannot be discovered on SeaTalk app Cannot be interacted with on SeaTalk Can enable capabilities|Transitions automatically to Online when conditions are met|
|Online|Your app is fully set up and functioning.|Can call APIs Can be discovered on SeaTalk app Can be interacted with on SeaTalk Can enable and disable capabilities|Transitions automatically to Not Configured if all capabilities are disabled Can be manually set to Maintenance|
|Maintenance|You or another app developer can set the app to this status to temporarily limit user interactions while making changes to the app.|Can call APIs excluding Messaging APIs Can be discovered on SeaTalk app Cannot be interacted with on SeaTalk Can enable and disable capabilties|Transitions automatically to Not Configured if all capabilities are disabled Can be manually set to Online|
|Offline|An SOP admin has taken your app offline due to misuse, sensitive information or to control risk.|Cannot call APIs Cannot be discovered on SeaTalk app Cannot be interacted with on SeaTalk Cannot enable capabilties; can disable capabilties|Cannot be changed on SOP. Please contact admin for resolution steps.|

## View app status

1. App List: [open.seatalk.io](open.seatalk.io) > My Apps
   * View at a glance the statuses of all apps that you are an Owner or Collaborator of in the App Status column
   * ![](data:image/png;base64,)
2. App Profile
   * From the App List, click on any app to enter its profile
   * App status can be found on the top left hand corner, below the app name and icon
   * ![](data:image/png;base64,)

## Change app status

* From the App Profile, if the app status is **Online** or **Maintenance,** click on the status to change it
* ![](data:image/png;base64,)
